description: This file defines the AppDelegate class for the macOS part of a Flutter application. It customizes application behavior such as termination after the last window closes and support for secure restorable state.

classes.name: AppDelegate
classes.description: A subclass of FlutterAppDelegate that handles application lifecycle events.

methods.name: applicationShouldTerminateAfterLastWindowClosed
methods.description: Returns true to indicate the application should terminate when the last window is closed.

methods.name: applicationSupportsSecureRestorableState
methods.description: Returns true to support secure state restoration.
